title: GenuinHB Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the GenuinHB adapter and its aliases. The shape depends on the alias's source type: vast-tag (customerId, tagId) or gam-wrapper (adUnitPath, cpm, custParams, descriptionUrl).

customerId.description: vast-tag: Genuin ad server customer ID, used as the {customerId} path segment of the VAST tag URL

tagId.description: vast-tag: Genuin ad server tag ID, used as the {tagId} path segment of the VAST tag URL

adUnitPath.description: gam-wrapper: Google Ad Manager ad unit path, e.g. /21775744923/genuin/instream (the iu parameter)

cpm.description: gam-wrapper: the price the GAM wrapper bid competes at (CPM, USD); policy, not a real bid

custParams.description: gam-wrapper: key-values sent to GAM as cust_params

descriptionUrl.description: gam-wrapper: the description_url sent to GAM; defaults to site.page, then app.storeurl

sizes.description: gam-wrapper: extra GAM master video ad slot sizes ("WxH") offered after the imp's size in the tag's sz list; use the sizes the GAM line items are trafficked at
